tool.name: Akita Predict
tool.description: Predict Hi-C contact maps using Hi-cGAN
tool.command:
bash $__tool_directory__/run_tool.sh && mkdir -p akita_data/fasta &&
cp -r $fasta_seq akita_data/fasta/ &&
echo "${model.fields.path}" && ls -lah "${model.fields.path}" && ln -s "${model.fields.path}" model.keras && #set $input_folder_bigwig="corigami_data/bigwig/" #set $input_folder_fasta="akita_data/fasta/"
python predict.py --region --output outputFolder

param.name: fasta_seq
param.label: Input DNA sequence
param.help: Select a DNA sequence as FASTA file.

param.name: region
param.label: Prediction region
param.help: Enter the region to predict e.g. chr12:115163136-116211712

tool.help:
This tool predicts Hi-C contact maps from chromatin folders using a pre-trained HiC-GAN model.
**Inputs:** - Chromatin folder containing bigWig files. - Select a preinstalled model. - Chromosomes to predict. - Output file for parameters.
**Output:** - A .cool file containing the predicted Hi-C contact map. - A .txt file with prediction parameters.
